headline: Samsung Electronics Posts Record Q3 Profit Exceeding 100 Trillion Won
summary: Samsung Electronics reported record third-quarter profits, becoming the first tech firm to top 100 trillion won in profit.
why: Samsung Electronics is the world's largest memory chip manufacturer and a key bellwether for global consumer electronics and semiconductor demand.

impacts.name: Samsung Electronics
impacts.why: Record high quarterly profits demonstrate strong semiconductor market demand.

why_moved: Record profits driven by semiconductor demand reinforce investor confidence in memory chip market recovery.
